BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: B.TECH/B.ARCH   SEMESTER: V
BRANCH: ALL   SESSION: MO/2022

SUBJECT: CE428 CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT

TIME: 2 HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 25.
2. Candidates attempt for all 25 marks.
3. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
4. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
5. Tables/Data hand book/Graph paper etc. to be supplied to the candidates in the examination hall.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


    CO BL
Q1(a) Why is construction management needed? [2] 1 2
Q1(b) Discuss the difference between good project leader and poor project leader. [3] 1 2


Q2(a) Why are pure project organizations least common now a days? [2] 1 2
Q2(b) Discuss different hierarchies of management level. [3] 1 2


Q3(a) Write short notes on project cash flow diagram. [2] 2 2
Q3(b) Discuss the  difference  between  preliminary  estimate  and  detailed  estimate  of  a
particular project.
[3] 2 3


Q4(a) Discuss about benefit cost ratio of public projects. [2] 2 2
Q4(b) A  govt.  is  planning  for  hydraulic  project  that  will  also  provide  flood  control,
irrigation  and  recreation  benefits.  The  established  benefits  and  cost  of  the  three
alternatives are given in the Table 1. The interest rate are to be used for analysis is
5%. The life of each alternatives X, Y and Z are assumed to be as 50 years. Select
the best alternative.

Table 1:                                  (All values in Crores)

Alternatives X Y Z
Initial cost 250.00 350.00 500.00
Annual power sales 10.00 12.00 18.00
Annual flood control 2.50 3.50 5.00
Annual irrigation benefit 3.50 4.50 6.00
Annual recreation benefits 1.00 2.00 3.50
Annual operation and
maintenance
2.00 2.50 3.50

[3] 2 4


Q5(a) Discuss about objectives of construction material management. [2] 3 2
Q5(b) What are the different functions of material management? [3] 3 2
